title: Minute Steak

items.item: spices: crushed pepper, cumin, coriander, pepper, salt

instructions: Heat some oil in a pan over medium flame. Add the minute steak and brown both sides, then take it off and put it on a plate.
Add the onion and sauté until soft, a few minutes (it will turn yellowish).
Add the mushrooms and garlic and cook until the mushrooms start to brown. Add the potatoes and sauté for about 2 minutes.
Add the tomato sauce, water, and spices.
Add the meat back. Bring to a boil, then lower the flame and simmer for about 1 hour, until the meat is soft (check with a fork).
